construction.findings: Hexagons clip cleanly to the square module boundary; visible dark grout is deliberate and the slab stays continuous.

readability.findings: White hex pattern and sparse slate accents remain legible in close oblique and phone views.

limitations: Stylized, inferred dimensions; not a measured as-built reconstruction.
